The '''Hydra system''' was located in the [[Catarlo sector/Legends|Catarlo sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the entities known as the [[maggot-cyborgs of Hydra]].<ref name="GaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hydra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-3.<ref name="EAOC" />
